decisions.reason: The Demeter natural yogurt is a low-cost line extension of an established range, and it remained on the website a year after launch, so it still offers option value at little carrying cost.
The mild sliced cheese launched only in 2024 and has its own page, so its uncertainty has not yet resolved, and it uses existing in-house cheesemaking at low incremental cost.
The sliced butter cheese is a recent launch close to the core business, and with no evidence yet that its value will not be realized, keeping the cheap option open is justified.
